memories.author: patient
memories.text: Intake note: 45-year-old bank branch manager. Mostly desk-bound, little exercise. Says he was told he has 'sugar' at a health camp. Asks whether he can still eat rice, as it is served at every meal at home.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Lab report: HbA1c (glycated haemoglobin) 9.4 % (reference below 5.7 %). Fasting plasma glucose 186 mg/dL (reference 70 to 99 mg/dL). Serum creatinine 0.9 mg/dL (reference 0.7 to 1.3 mg/dL).

memories.author: D01
memories.text:
S: New diagnosis of T2DM on screening. Sedentary, desk job. Calls it 'sugar'. No polyuria or weight loss reported. Asked whether he can keep eating rice.
O: BP 128/82 mmHg, pulse 80/min, ht 172 cm, wt 88 kg, BMI 29.7. HbA1c 9.4 %, fasting glucose 186 mg/dL. Creatinine 0.9 mg/dL.
A: 1. T2DM, newly diagnosed, HbA1c 9.4 %. 2. Overweight, BMI 29.7.
P: 1. Start metformin (Glycomet) 500 mg BD with meals. 2. Cut white rice to 1 cup per meal; switch to brown rice or millets (ragi, jowar). 3. Walk 30 min, 5 days a week. 4. Aim to lose 5 kg. 5. Repeat HbA1c in 3 months. 6. Diabetes education given.
Adv: Brown rice or millets instead of white rice, max 1 cup per meal; walk 30 min, 5 days a week; lose 5 kg. R/V in 3 months.

memories.author: D01
memories.text: Rx: metformin 500 mg BD with breakfast and dinner. New start.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Lab report: HbA1c (glycated haemoglobin) 7.2 % (reference below 5.7 %). Sample: venous blood, Sunrise Family Clinic.

memories.author: D01
memories.text:
S: Feels better, more energy. Taking metformin regularly, no GI side effects. Rice cut to about one cup at dinner, still has white rice at lunch. Walking twice a week only.
O: BP 124/80 mmHg, pulse 76/min, wt 85 kg. HbA1c 7.2 %, down from 9.4 %.
A: 1. T2DM, improving, near target. 2. Overweight, weight falling.
P: 1. Continue metformin 500 mg BD. 2. Continue rice and walking plan. 3. Brown rice or millets at lunch as well.
Adv: Switch fully to brown rice or ragi; walk 30 min, 5 days a week; lose 5 kg. R/V in 4 months.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Lab report: HbA1c (glycated haemoglobin) 6.8 % (reference below 5.7 %). Sample: venous blood, Sunrise Family Clinic.

memories.author: D01
memories.text:
S: Compliant with metformin. Still has white rice at weekend dinners. Walking 2 to 3 times a week. No hypoglycaemia. Asks whether the plan is working.
O: BP 126/80 mmHg, pulse 74/min, wt 84 kg. HbA1c 6.8 %, down from 7.2 %.
A: 1. T2DM, well controlled on metformin alone. 2. Overweight, improving.
P: 1. Continue metformin 500 mg BD, unchanged. 2. Repeat advice: cut white rice to 1 cup per meal; switch to brown rice or millets (ragi, jowar). 3. Walk 30 min, 5 days a week. 4. Lose 5 kg.
Adv: As above. Avoid sugared tea and cold drinks. R/V in 6 months.

memories.author: D01
memories.text: Dilated fundus examination of both eyes, done as part of the annual diabetes review. Findings: normal, with no diabetic retinopathy seen in either eye. Macula and optic discs appear normal on examination. Next annual dilated examination due in 2027.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Lab report: HbA1c (glycated haemoglobin) 6.6 % (reference below 5.7 %). Sample: venous blood, Sunrise Family Clinic.

memories.author: D01
memories.text:
S: Feels well. Metformin taken regularly, no GI upset. Brown rice most days, white rice only occasionally at weekends. Walking about 3 times a week.
O: BP 122/78 mmHg, pulse 72/min, wt 82 kg (88 kg in June 2025), BMI 27.7. HbA1c 6.6 %.
A: 1. T2DM, well controlled on metformin. 2. Overweight, weight down 6 kg; 5 kg target reached.
P: 1. Continue metformin 500 mg BD. 2. Continue the same plan: 1 cup rice per meal, brown rice or millets. 3. Repeat HbA1c in 6 months.
Adv: Keep walking 30 min, 5 days a week; maintain current weight. R/V in 6 months.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up with Dr Anjali Mehta (D01) booked for 2027-01-19 at 09:00, for review and repeat HbA1c. Fasting is not required for the HbA1c test. Please bring your metformin strip and any home sugar readings.
